entries.notes: Fixed a real gap while closing this: renderObjectRows never trimmed the search filter, so leading/trailing whitespace silently produced zero matches (src/app.js renderObjectRows now does filter.trim().toLowerCase()). Case-folding and non-Latin source-script substring matching already worked correctly.

entries.title: Reader link targets individually hidden object
evidence: tests/e2e/view-index-solo.spec.js :: a Reader link to an individually hidden object still commits it safely (P-SCN-108)
entries.notes: commitFocus has no visibility guard (only byId[id] existence) — a Reader link commits its target even when View currently hides it. Confirmed correct as-is: the object's visibility is a View preference, not a constraint on what the reader can navigate to.

entries.title: Reader link targets group-hidden object
evidence: tests/e2e/view-index-solo.spec.js :: a Reader link to a group-hidden object still commits it safely (P-SCN-109)
entries.notes: Same as P-SCN-108, for a type-group hide rather than an individual one. Confirmed correct as-is.

entries.title: Projected-edge generator list opens a hidden RelO
evidence: tests/e2e/view-index-solo.spec.js :: the projected-edge generator list opens a hidden RelO safely (P-SCN-110)
entries.notes: bindIndexItems' generator-list click handler (used for an FO's relation-objects list) has the same no-visibility-guard commit path as Reader links. Confirmed correct as-is.

entries.title: Enter Solo when core is individually or group hidden
evidence: tests/e2e/view-index-solo.spec.js :: entering Solo reveals a core that was individually or group hidden (P-SCN-111)
entries.notes: nodeVisible()'s S.soloSet branch checks membership only (soloSet.has(id)), bypassing objectVisibility/objectGroups entirely while Solo is active — so entering Solo already correctly reveals a hidden core and its members, matching Solo's 'lens that supersedes View' framing (P-RULE-012/013). Confirmed correct as-is.

entries.title: Change visibility while Solo is active then exit
evidence: tests/unit/reducer.test.js :: ENTER_SOLO captures a snapshot once; EXIT_SOLO restores it exactly (P-RULE-012)

entries.title: Clear Route while trace animation is active
evidence: tests/e2e/route-trace.spec.js :: Clear Route and Clear field trace are independent: clearing one never touches the other (P-RULE-010)
entries.notes: Covers the independence claim; not literally timed against an in-flight trace animation.

entries.title: Clear trace during camera/focus transition
evidence: tests/e2e/route-trace.spec.js :: Clear Route and Clear field trace are independent: clearing one never touches the other (P-RULE-010)
entries.notes: Covers the independence claim; not literally timed against an in-flight camera transition.

entries.title: Late font-ready or layout-completion callback after newer commit
evidence: tests/unit/transactions.test.js :: stale callbacks are unable to commit presentation: isActive is false once superseded

entries.title: Very long Route with five hundred or more direct commits
evidence: tests/unit/route.test.js :: a 500+ event route window is virtualized without deleting any semantic event (D-DEC-22, P-RULE-039)

entries.title: Same object activated through different channels
evidence: tests/unit/reducer.test.js :: COMMIT_OBJECT with the same id appends nothing (P-RULE-004)
tests/unit/pointer-ownership.test.js :: keyboard activation bypasses the pointer solver entirely: a direct dispatch needs no pointer module at all
entries.notes: Multiple channels dispatch the same idempotent COMMIT_OBJECT; not a single combined multi-channel test.

entries.title: Background interaction attempted while modal is open
evidence: tests/e2e/modals-about.spec.js :: the background is genuinely inert while a modal is open, and replacement never leaks focus to it

entries.title: All-hidden Field followed by Route replay and Index open
evidence: tests/e2e/view-index-solo.spec.js :: the all-hidden state is explicit and offers a one-action local recovery (D-DEC-09)
tests/e2e/view-index-solo.spec.js :: Route replay never changes visibility, even for a currently-hidden target (P-RULE-017)

entries.title: Page resumes after afterglow duration elapsed while hidden
evidence: tests/unit/trace.test.js :: reconcileTraceDeadlines removes only expired entries against wall-clock time, without replay (P-RULE-030)

entries.title: Rapid commits produce assistive status without announcement flood
evidence: tests/e2e/tooltip-keyboard-status.spec.js :: rapid status messages coalesce: only the latest meaningful message is published (T-REQ-037)

entries.title: Tooltip is repositioned or dismissed during resize
evidence: tests/e2e/tooltip-keyboard-status.spec.js :: an open preview is dismissed on resize rather than left stale-positioned (P-SCN-122)
entries.notes: Fixed a real gap while closing this: resize() never touched an open preview, which is positioned once from hover-time pointer coordinates and never recalculated, so it could be left stale-positioned after a resize. resize() now calls clearTouch() (dismiss, the simpler and safer of the two options the scenario names) and clears any pending hover timer.

entries.title: Mobile virtual keyboard opens during Index search
evidence: tests/e2e/mobile-chambers.spec.js :: start() wires the visualViewport resize listener and an immediate resize reconciles again; stop() unwires it (T-REQ-041)
tests/e2e/mobile-chambers.spec.js :: the virtual keyboard opening during an active Index search leaves the search input and results reachable (P-SCN-123)
entries.notes: Original evidence covered only the isolated visualViewport mechanism with fake env/doc collaborators, never combined with an open Index search on the live app. Verified directly and added dedicated coverage: simulating a real keyboard open (visualViewport.height shrinks, window.innerHeight/100vh stays put -- unlike setViewportSize) leaves both the search input and its results reachable within the visible area.

entries.title: Projected-edge inspection with screen reader
evidence: tests/e2e/tooltip-keyboard-status.spec.js :: inspecting a projected edge updates the Reader region with an accessible name for the pair (P-SCN-124)
entries.notes: renderEdgePanel's #reader content names both endpoints (not just 'Projected edge'), confirmed against the live app's actual rendered text -- what a screen reader would read from that region.

entries.title: Narrow 320px viewport preserves all capabilities
evidence: tests/e2e/environmental-resilience.spec.js :: the composition grid reflows to 320px CSS width with no horizontal overflow, and a 200%-zoom-equivalent viewport keeps the bottom-nav fully in view (T-REQ-040)
tests/e2e/responsive-visual-closure.spec.js :: 320px viewport preserves all core capabilities, not just layout reflow (P-SCN-125)
entries.notes: Original evidence covered layout reflow only. Verified directly and added dedicated coverage: commit, View drawer + type toggle, Index search, and Field<->Read surface switch all work correctly at 320px.

entries.title: Reduced motion combined with rapid commit and modal change
evidence: tests/e2e/tooltip-keyboard-status.spec.js :: reduced motion, a rapid commit, and a modal change together produce no error and a consistent final state (P-SCN-126)
entries.notes: Reduced motion + rapid commit + an overlapping modal open/close (About) together produce no error and land on the correct final state -- the three-way combination the existing pairwise-only tests did not exercise together.

entries.title: Connectivity changes after core work has loaded
evidence: tests/e2e/environmental-resilience.spec.js :: createLifecycleController only ever dispatches RECONCILE_* commands, never a Route/trace command (T-REQ-042)

entries.title: Assistive reading order across landmarks and responsive chambers
evidence: tests/e2e/tooltip-keyboard-status.spec.js :: landmark DOM order is identical across desktop and mobile, so assistive reading order does not depend on viewport (P-SCN-128)
entries.notes: Responsive layout is CSS-only (display/position changes, e.g. .rail{display:none} on mobile); confirmed the DOM order of nav/main/dialog landmarks themselves is never reordered between desktop and a 390px mobile viewport, so a screen reader's linear reading order is stable across responsive chambers.

entries.title: Keyboard navigation in dense cluster after filters change
evidence: tests/e2e/tooltip-keyboard-status.spec.js :: keyboard navigation still resolves correctly in a dense cluster after a View filter change (P-SCN-129)
entries.notes: updateRovingTabindex/nearestNodeInDirection both already gate on nodeVisible(); confirmed the roving target and arrow-key directional movement never land on a type hidden by a View filter change, and Enter commits the correct, still-visible node.

entries.title: Duplicate touch/click event sequence on one activation
evidence: tests/unit/pointer-ownership.test.js :: a synthetic click immediately after a real pointer commit is suppressed, then stops being suppressed
